title: Hoke Barbaad Mai Aayi Hu
body:
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Sath saoghate safar layi hun kya kay mere nana -
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Maine choda tha Madina to bhara ghar tha mera
Bhai shabbir as  the abbase as dilawar tha mera
Sath aya hai alam khun me duba mere nana –
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Chhe mahine ka wo Asghar bhi nahi bach paya
Phool si jan pe ada ko taras na aya
Zulm ke teer se mara gaya bachha mere nana –
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Teri tasweer meri ankho ka tara Akbar
Ho gaya khun me ghaltan wo mera nure nazar
Uske sine pe bhi mara gaya naiza mere nana –
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Mere bhai ko laino ne bahot tadpaya
Kund khanjar se hi kata hai gala pyase ka
Khun bhara sath mai le ayi hun kurta mere nana –
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Choor masum thi zakhmo se jala tha kurta
Dil me arman sajae thi watan ane ka
Rahegai sham ke zindan me Sakina mere nana –
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Kaise batlaun jo ummat ne mujhe zakhm diye
Sham o Kufa ke dayaro me phiraya hai mujhe
Apne balon se chupati rahi chaehra mere nana –
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
Qabre mursal saww pe qayamat ka sama tha manzar
Ro ke zinab sa
Ne jo shano se hatayi chadar
Neel shano ke abhi dekho hai taza mere nana –
Ho ke barbad mai ayi hun Madina mere nana ×2
